body: Agree sa scouting value, pero ang trap is measuring solver speed instead of total engineering effort. A 10× faster reduced model can still lose if engineers spend days cleaning interfaces, validating correlations, or debugging coupled-model failures. My evidence test: show total person-hours from model preparation to validated decision, plus error versus physical test. Kung walang ganung denominator, ‘faster simulation’ is technically true but operationally incomplete.

claims.text: Solver-speed improvements alone may not translate into lower total engineering effort when integration and validation work are included.
claims.basis: Evaluation criterion derived from the article's explicit evidence limitations
